annotations.title: Preview a Discord server on AiGuild

description: Use this when the user wants to create, set up or reorganize a Discord server and a structure (categories, channels, roles) has been designed with them. Do not use it for general Discord questions, moderation help, or requests that do not involve setting up a server. It returns a preview of the structure and a link to aiguild.me; nothing is created or changed on Discord. On aiguild.me the user signs in with Discord, reviews or edits the structure and applies it to a server they manage; existing channels are kept by default.

categories.description: Categories in display order, each with its channels. A typical server has 4 to 8 categories and 15 to 40 channels.

access.description: everyone: members can read and write. read_only: members read, staff writes (rules, announcements). staff: staff only. admin: admins only. roles: only the roles listed in roles (plus staff).

emoji.description: One emoji shown before the channel name.

name.description: Channel name without emoji, e.g. general, rules, Lounge.

roles.description: With access=roles: names of roles from the roles list allowed in this channel.

topic.description: Channel topic shown under its name.

emoji.description: One emoji shown before the category name.

name.description: Category name without emoji, e.g. Welcome, Community, Staff.

description.description: One or two sentences about the community.

language.description: Language of the server: channel names and the bot's messages. Use en for a language not listed.

roles.description: Roles from the most powerful to the least. Do not include @everyone.

level.description: Permission level: owner (administrator), admin, moderator, special (VIP, booster, no extra permission) or member.

server_name.description: Name of the Discord server, e.g. Survival Haven.

systems.description: Bot systems AiGuild sets up when the structure is applied. Welcome and levels are on by default; basic AutoMod protection (invite links, mention raids) is always switched on.

levels.description: Level system (XP and rank cards). Default true.

rules.description: Server rules members must accept with a button before seeing the server (Markdown allowed).

tickets.description: Ticket types for a support panel with AI first replies, e.g. Support, Report a member, Partnership.

description.description: Hint shown in the ticket form.

welcome_message.description: Message posted when a member joins. {user} mentions the member, {server} is the server name.
